verdict.rationale: Justworks documents a Xero integration where pay types are mapped to Chart of Accounts, with department/office/employee-level overrides, implying automated syncing of payroll journal entries to Xero. However, there is no mention of QuickBooks sync specifically, and no detail on sync frequency, error handling, or independent confirmation of reliability. Missing for 10: QuickBooks integration evidence, details on automatic/scheduled sync cadence, and third-party/hands-on validation of the Xero sync working reliably.
